title: Umhlebi weGolide entlango
intro: Khawucinge ngenkampu enkulu yasentlango ngexesha lokulinda nokungaqiniseki. Inkokeli enkulu ihambile iye kwintlanganiso noThixo, ishiya uluntu lulangazelela into ebonakalayo yokuyibamba. Kuloo khefu lingenaxhala, umntu okholisayo uhamba phambili enezithembiso ezikhazimlayo kunye nesidalwa esikrelekrele esibonakala siphila.
clues: Ndandiphakathi kwabo bashiya iYiputa noMusa, sibona ulwandle luqhekeka ukuze sibaleke.
Ndibukele xa inkokeli yethu yayisiya entabeni kangangeentsuku ezingamashumi amane ukuze ifumane ulwalathiso.
Ndaqokelela izinto zokuhombisa ebantwini ndaza ndazibumba ngezandla zam.
Ndenza ithole elalinesandi esikhulu, ndaza ndababiza abantu ukuba beze kulo.
Ndathabatha uthuli oluncinci emzileni wesithunywa ndaluphosa kwinto endiyenzileyo.
Ndajongwa nguMusa ndaza ndagwetywa ukuba ndithi 'ungandichukumisi' kwaye ndihlale ngokwahlukeneyo, ndithembise intlanganiso yomgwebo.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
